material_input_classification.input: synthetic risk-adjusted expected net commercial value, cost, downside, sensitivity, and fallback mechanics
firm-authorized services, territories, economics, costs, risk policy, and effective dates
real booking, commission, cost, and territory data sources
modeled-versus-realized value measured against authorized firm evidence
sealed economics attacks and external hidden economics evaluation

hard_boundaries: Only versioned authoritative economics are accepted by the engine.
Modeled value is never called realized net commercial value; the level-9 realized-value ceiling is preserved.
Costs, downside, and conversion uncertainty are never omitted or collapsed.
Sensitivity-only ranking is never used as a decision input.
Live actions, external writes, deployment, publication, credentials, and representative authority remain disabled.
Synthetic economics proof does not establish firm economics, realized value, commercial lift, or production readiness.
